top_signals.title: Post-Strike Movie Supply is Driving Theatre Demand, Vue Entertainment CEO says
top_signals.summary: Vue Entertainment CEO Tim Richards says the chain may see its strongest summer box office since the pandemic. "What we are seeing this year is all the movies in the post-strike period now hitting out screens. But we are also seeing the studios and content-makers producing and releasing movies at unprecedented levels." He speaks to Bloomberg's Guy Johnson, Tom Mackenzie, and Skylar Montgomery Koning. (Source: Bloomberg)
